display_name: Generali Corporate / 忠利集团企业报告风格

user_reference_decks: 开门红储蓄型保险的“人、货、场”V2（广州AIA）.pptx
provenance.note: Engineering approximation, not an official licensed brand book.

color_rules: Use brand red for conclusion, KPI emphasis and focal data series.
Use white/light neutral backgrounds for analytical pages.
Use charcoal body text; avoid red paragraphs.
Exact HEX values are approximations and must be calibrated from source assets.

typography.title: Strong sans-serif, short declarative conclusion
typography.numbers: Tabular numerals and oversized key figures

iconography.style: One consistent line-icon or restrained solid geometric family
iconography.stroke: Consistent stroke weight and optical size
iconography.semantic_rule: Icons encode category or action, never decorate empty space
iconography.density_rule: Use icons for repeated taxonomies/process nodes; avoid one-off icon clutter

principles: Choose chart from analytical question, not aesthetic preference.
Use red for focal series and neutral greys for context.
Direct-label values and units when it reduces legend lookup.
Show baseline, period, scope and source.
Use small multiples for segment comparisons.
Encode actuals, targets and forecasts consistently.

information_architecture.high_density_rule: Increase capacity through grouping, hierarchy, direct labels and spatial structure; do not solve by shrinking fonts.

anti_patterns: equal-weight card grids when one conclusion should dominate
red text on pale red with insufficient contrast
repeated index slides without narrative purpose
